mapper.select: SELECT user_id, weight, goal_weight, start, finish, pfc, created_at, updated_at FROM users_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users_goal (user_id, weight, goal_weight, start, finish, pfc, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{weight}, #{goalWeight}, #{start}, #{finish}, #{pfc}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET weight=EXCLUDED.weight, goal_weight=EXCLUDED.goal_weight, start=EXCLUDED.start, finish=EXCLUDED.finish, pfc=EXCLUDED.pfc, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
